notes: Settings & Config's multi-account watchlist field only offered a single free-text input per account, even though the server has always supported comma-separated multiple watchlist IDs per account (_do_full_harvest splits account.watchlistId on ','). Each account row now has a proper '+ Add Watchlist' control to add/remove individual watchlist IDs, stored and loaded correctly, joined into the same comma-separated wire format the server already parses. Verified live against real account data: adding a second watchlist ID and saving produces the expected comma-separated payload.
